remove-all-annotations-from-pdf.title: Remove All Annotations from a PDF using PdfAnnotationEditor
remove-all-annotations-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF file to Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor, delete every annotation in the document, and save the cleaned PDF to a new file.

remove-all-annotations-from-pdfs.title: Remove All Annotations from PDFs in a Folder
remove-all-annotations-from-pdfs.description: Shows how to loop through PDF files in a directory, bind each with PdfAnnotationEditor, delete every annotation, and overwrite the original file.

delete-text-annotations-from-pdf.title: Delete Text Annotations from PDF
delete-text-annotations-from-pdf.description: Shows how to remove only text (sticky note) annotations from a PDF by using PdfAnnotationEditor.DeleteAnnotations with the type name "Text".

remove-link-annotations-from-pdf.title: Remove Link Annotations from PDF
remove-link-annotations-from-pdf.description: Shows how to delete link annotations in a PDF using the PdfAnnotationEditor facade from Aspose.Pdf.

delete-pdf-annotation-by-name.title: Delete a PDF Annotation by Name
delete-pdf-annotation-by-name.description: Shows how to remove a specific annotation identified by its name from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor.

delete-pdf-annotation-by-name__v2.title: Delete PDF Annotation by Name
delete-pdf-annotation-by-name__v2.description: Shows how to remove a specific annotation from a PDF document by passing its name to the DeleteAnnotation method of PdfAnnotationEditor.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF with PdfAnnotationEditor and export all its annotations to an XFDF file using a file stream.

export-annotations-to-xfdf-stream.title: Export Annotations from Specific PDF Pages to XFDF Stream
export-annotations-to-xfdf-stream.description: Shows how to bind a PDF, export annotations from pages 1‑2 into an XFDF memory stream, and optionally read the XFDF content.

export-highlight-annotations-to-xfdf.title: Export Highlight Annotations to XFDF
export-highlight-annotations-to-xfdf.description: Demonstrates how to filter PDF annotations by the Highlight type and export them to an XFDF file using the PdfAnnotationEditor overload.

import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdf.title: Import XFDF Annotations into PDF
import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdf.description: Shows how to bind a PDF with PdfAnnotationEditor, import annotations from an XFDF file, and save the updated PDF.

import-xfdf-annotations-to-specific-page.title: Import XFDF Annotations to Specific PDF Pages
import-xfdf-annotations-to-specific-page.description: Demonstrates how to import annotations from an XFDF file into a PDF and retain them only on a defined page range.

import-annotations-without-overwrite.title: Import Annotations Without Overwriting Existing Ones
import-annotations-without-overwrite.description: Demonstrates how to import annotations from one or more source PDFs into a target PDF while preserving any annotations already present, using the PdfAnnotationEditor facade.

flatten-pdf-annotations.title: Flatten PDF Annotations to Non‑Editable Elements
flatten-pdf-annotations.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor to flatten all annotations in a PDF, converting them to static visual content, and then save the result.

flatten-annotations-first-five-pages.title: Flatten Annotations on the First Five PDF Pages
flatten-annotations-first-five-pages.description: Demonstrates how to use the PdfAnnotationEditor facade to flatten all annotation types on pages 1 through 5 of a PDF document and save the result.

modify-annotation-author-on-pdf-page.title: Modify Annotation Author on a PDF Page
modify-annotation-author-on-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to change the author (Title) of text annotations on a specific page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor.

update-annotation-subject-color.title: Update Annotation Subject and Color
update-annotation-subject-color.description: Shows how to change the subject text and color of an existing PDF annotation by creating a new TextAnnotation and applying it with PdfAnnotationEditor.ModifyAnnotations.

set-annotation-open-flag.title: Set Annotation Open Flag for All PDF Annotations
set-annotation-open-flag.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through all pages and annotations in a PDF and set the Open flag to true for text and popup annotations using Aspose.Pdf.

update-annotation-modified-date.title: Update Annotation Modified Date in PDF
update-annotation-modified-date.description: Shows how to set the Modified property of a PDF annotation to the current system time using PdfAnnotationEditor.ModifyAnnotations.

set-readonly-flag-on-pdf-text-annotation.title: Set Read‑Only Flag on PDF Text Annotation
set-readonly-flag-on-pdf-text-annotation.description: Demonstrates creating a TextAnnotation, applying the ReadOnly flag via the Flags property, and adding it to a PDF using PdfAnnotationEditor.ModifyAnnotations.

batch-update-annotation-author.title: Batch Update Annotation Author Across Multiple PDFs
batch-update-annotation-author.description: Shows how to iterate through PDF files in a directory and use PdfAnnotationEditor to replace the author of existing annotations with a new value, saving the modified PDFs to an output folder.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf__v2.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF Using MemoryStream
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf__v2.description: Shows how to bind a PDF from a byte array via MemoryStream, export all its annotations to an XFDF stream, and return the XFDF data as a byte array.

import-annotations-from-xfdf-stream.title: Import Annotations from XFDF Stream into PDF
import-annotations-from-xfdf-stream.description: Shows how to load a PDF and an XFDF annotation file from streams, import the annotations using PdfAnnotationEditor, and save the updated PDF without creating temporary files.

delete-flatten-pdf-annotations.title: Delete and Flatten PDF Annotations
delete-flatten-pdf-annotations.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor to remove all annotations from a PDF, flatten any remaining ones, and save the processed document.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-and-valid.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF and Validate Against Schema
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-and-valid.description: The example exports annotations from a PDF to an XFDF file using the Form facade, then validates the generated XFDF against the official XFDF XSD schema.

delete-all-annotations-from-pdf.title: Delete All Annotations from PDF and Verify Count
delete-all-annotations-from-pdf.description: Shows how to bind a PDF with PdfAnnotationEditor, count existing annotations, remove them using DeleteAnnotations, and confirm the removal before saving the file.

extract-pdf-annotation-details.title: Extract PDF Annotation Details to DTO
extract-pdf-annotation-details.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, extract all annotations using PdfAnnotationEditor, and map their name, type, and rectangle into a custom DTO for further analysis.

export-pdf-annotations-to-json.title: Export PDF Annotations and Form Fields to JSON Log
export-pdf-annotations-to-json.description: Shows how to load a PDF, bind it to the annotation editor facade, and export form field (widget) annotations to a JSON file for auditing purposes.

delete-pdf-annotation-with-error-handlin.title: Delete PDF Annotation with Error Handling
delete-pdf-annotation-with-error-handlin.description: Demonstrates deleting an annotation from a PDF using PdfAnnotationEditor and handling exceptions when the specified annotation does not exist.

delete-annotations-by-author.title: Delete Annotations by Author Using Aspose.Pdf
delete-annotations-by-author.description: Shows how to filter PDF annotations by the author's Title and remove them using PdfAnnotationEditor.

delete-pdf-annotations-by-color.title: Delete PDF Annotations by Specific Color
delete-pdf-annotations-by-color.description: Shows how to iterate through a PDF, compare each annotation's Color with a target RGB value, and delete only those annotations that match the color.

export-import-pdf-annotations-xfdf.title: Export and Import PDF Annotations via XFDF
export-import-pdf-annotations-xfdf.description: Demonstrates exporting all annotations from a source PDF to an XFDF file and then importing that XFDF into another PDF to duplicate the annotation layout.

batch-flatten-pdf-annotations.title: Batch Flatten PDF Annotations
batch-flatten-pdf-annotations.description: Processes every PDF in a specified folder, flattens all annotations using Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor, and saves the result with a "_flattened" suffix.

batch-delete-stamp-annotations.title: Batch Delete Stamp Annotations from PDFs
batch-delete-stamp-annotations.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through PDF files in a folder and remove all stamp annotations using Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor facade, saving the cleaned documents.

import-xfdf-annotations-into-multiple-pd.title: Import XFDF Annotations into Multiple PDFs
import-xfdf-annotations-into-multiple-pd.description: Demonstrates how to import a single XFDF file with reviewer comments and apply those annotations to several PDF documents, saving the annotated versions.

delete-pdf-annotations-in-parallel.title: Delete All Annotations from PDFs in Parallel
delete-pdf-annotations-in-parallel.description: Shows how to remove all annotations from multiple PDF files concurrently using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor with Parallel.ForEach for faster processing.

measure-annotation-flattening-performanc.title: Measure Annotation Flattening Performance
measure-annotation-flattening-performanc.description: The example loads a PDF, flattens all its annotations using PdfAnnotationEditor, saves the result, and measures the elapsed time to evaluate performance impact.

list-pdf-annotation-names.title: List PDF Annotation Names
list-pdf-annotation-names.description: Shows how to bind a PDF with PdfAnnotationEditor, iterate through each page and its annotations, and print the Name of each annotation to the console for debugging.

delete-annotations-from-pdf.title: Delete All Annotations from PDF Using PdfAnnotationEditor
delete-annotations-from-pdf.description: Shows how to create a PDF with text annotations, remove them with PdfAnnotationEditor.DeleteAnnotations, and verify the removal with a unit test.

retry-delete-pdf-annotations.title: Retry Deleting PDF Annotations with PdfAnnotationEditor
retry-delete-pdf-annotations.description: Demonstrates binding a PDF, deleting all annotations, and retrying the operation with a rebinding if the first attempt fails.

log-annotation-deletions-to-csv.title: Log Annotation Deletions to CSV and Remove from PDF
log-annotation-deletions-to-csv.description: The example extracts all annotations from a PDF, records each annotation's name, type, and page number to a CSV log file, then deletes the annotations and saves the modified document.

delete-annotations-from-pdf-using-config.title: Delete Specific Annotations from PDF Using Configuration File
delete-annotations-from-pdf-using-config.description: Shows how to read annotation types from a text configuration file and delete those (or all) annotations from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

remove-all-annotations-from-pdf__v2.title: Remove All Annotations from PDF
remove-all-annotations-from-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF, delete every annotation using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor, and save the cleaned file.

batch-delete-pdf-annotations-with-progre.title: Batch Delete PDF Annotations with Progress
batch-delete-pdf-annotations-with-progre.description: Demonstrates how to remove all annotations from multiple PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor while showing a simple console progress percentage.

batch-flatten-pdf-annotations-cancellati.title: Batch Flatten PDF Annotations with Cancellation Support
batch-flatten-pdf-annotations-cancellati.description: Demonstrates flattening all annotations in multiple PDF files using Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor while allowing the operation to be aborted via a CancellationToken.

get-annotation-names-by-author.title: Get Annotation Names by Author from PDF
get-annotation-names-by-author.description: Demonstrates how to extract all annotations from a PDF and return the names of those markup annotations whose author (Subject) matches a specified string.

copy-annotations-to-multiple-pdfs.title: Copy Annotations from Template PDF to Multiple PDFs
copy-annotations-to-multiple-pdfs.description: Demonstrates exporting annotations from a template PDF to an XFDF stream and importing them into several target PDFs using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor.

flatten-pdf-annotations-verify-removal.title: Flatten PDF Annotations and Verify Removal
flatten-pdf-annotations-verify-removal.description: Loads a PDF, flattens all annotation objects using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, saves the result, and checks the document structure to ensure no annotations remain.

annotation-removal-report.title: Annotation Removal Report for PDFs
annotation-removal-report.description: Demonstrates how to count and delete all annotations from multiple PDF files using Aspose.Pdf and generate a CSV‑style report showing the number of annotations removed per file.

pdf-annotation-helper.title: PDF Annotation Helper for Binding, Deleting, Flattening, and Saving
pdf-annotation-helper.description: Shows a reusable helper class that wraps Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor to bind a PDF, delete annotations (all or by type), flatten annotations (all or by page range), and save the updated document.

remove-pdf-annotations.title: Remove All Annotations from a PDF Stream
remove-pdf-annotations.description: Shows how to bind a PDF stream to Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor, delete every annotation, and return the cleaned PDF as a MemoryStream.

async-pdf-annotation-operations.title: Asynchronous PDF Annotation Operations with Aspose.Pdf
async-pdf-annotation-operations.description: Demonstrates how to perform common PDF annotation tasks—flattening, deleting, importing, and exporting—using Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor wrapped in Task.Run for non‑blocking asynchronous execution.

delete-pdf-annotations-in-folder.title: Delete PDF Annotations in a Folder
delete-pdf-annotations-in-folder.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor to remove all annotations from each PDF file in a source directory and save the cleaned files.

log-update-annotation-modification-times.title: Log and Update Annotation Modification Timestamps
log-update-annotation-modification-times.description: Demonstrates how to read the Modified timestamp of each PDF annotation, log it, and set a new timestamp using Aspose.Pdf's annotation editor.

delete-annotations-with-backup.title: Delete All Annotations with Optional Backup
delete-annotations-with-backup.description: Demonstrates how to create a backup copy of a PDF before removing all annotations using Aspose.Pdf's annotation editor.

delete-pdf-annotations-by-name.title: Delete PDF Annotations by Name (Literal and Variable)
delete-pdf-annotations-by-name.description: Demonstrates removing specific PDF annotations using Aspose.Pdf by supplying the annotation name directly as a string literal or through a variable.

benchmark-delete-annotations.title: Benchmark Deleting PDF Annotations with Aspose.Pdf
benchmark-delete-annotations.description: Creates a PDF with multiple text annotations and measures the performance of deleting all annotations via DeleteAnnotations versus deleting a single annotation via DeleteAnnotation.

flatten-pdf-annotations-log-size-reducti.title: Flatten PDF Annotations and Log Size Reduction
flatten-pdf-annotations-log-size-reducti.description: Demonstrates how to flatten all annotations in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and then log the original and reduced file sizes for audit purposes.

extract-annotation-rectangles-to-pdf.title: Extract Annotation Rectangles and Visualize as PDF Pages
extract-annotation-rectangles-to-pdf.description: The example extracts the bounding rectangles of all annotations in a source PDF and creates a new PDF where each page visualizes one annotation rectangle with descriptive text.

add-text-annotation-with-custom-flags.title: Add Text Annotation with Custom Flags to PDF
add-text-annotation-with-custom-flags.description: Demonstrates creating a TextAnnotation, setting custom annotation flags (Invisible, NoZoom), and applying it to all pages using PdfAnnotationEditor.

flatten-annotations-network-share.title: Flatten Annotations in PDFs on a Network Share
flatten-annotations-network-share.description: Shows how to scan a UNC network folder for PDF files and use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor to flatten all annotations, saving the changes back to the original files.

flatten-pdf-annotations-verify.title: Flatten PDF Annotations and Verify Removal
flatten-pdf-annotations-verify.description: Demonstrates how to flatten all annotations in a PDF using PdfAnnotationEditor and then scan the saved document to ensure no annotation objects remain.

export-pdf-annotations-pretty-xfdf.title: Export PDF Annotations to Pretty-Printed XFDF
export-pdf-annotations-pretty-xfdf.description: Shows how to extract all annotations from a PDF and save them as an XFDF file with formatted (indented) XML for easier manual editing.

pdf-annotation-utility-delete-flatten-ex.title: Command‑Line PDF Annotation Utility (Delete, Flatten, Export)
pdf-annotation-utility-delete-flatten-ex.description: Demonstrates a console application that uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades to delete specific pages, flatten all annotations, or export annotations to an XFDF file based on command‑line arguments.

export-annotations-xfdf-no-annotations.title: Export Annotations to XFDF for PDF with No Annotations
export-annotations-xfdf-no-annotations.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF without any annotations, exporting the (empty) annotation set to XFDF using PdfAnnotationEditor, and validating the XFDF structure.

merge-multiple-xfdf-files.title: Merge Multiple XFDF Files into a Single XFDF
merge-multiple-xfdf-files.description: Demonstrates how to import annotations from several XFDF files into a temporary PDF using PdfAnnotationEditor and then export the combined annotations as one XFDF file.

export-import-flatten-pdf-annotations-lo.title: Export, Import and Flatten PDF Annotations with Verbose Logging
export-import-flatten-pdf-annotations-lo.description: The example loads a PDF, exports its annotations to an XFDF file, re-imports them, flattens the annotations into the page content, and saves the modified PDF while writing each step to a verbose log file.

retrieve-annotation-count-per-pdf-page.title: Retrieve Annotation Count Per PDF Page
retrieve-annotation-count-per-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates opening a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating through its pages, and counting the annotations on each page to produce a page‑wise report.

clone-modify-pdf-annotation.title: Clone and Modify PDF Annotation
clone-modify-pdf-annotation.description: Shows how to clone an existing annotation on a PDF page, change its properties, and add the cloned annotation back to the same page using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

batch-import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdfs.title: Batch Import XFDF Annotations into Matching PDFs
batch-import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdfs.description: Demonstrates iterating over PDF files, locating corresponding XFDF files by name, importing their annotations with PdfAnnotationEditor, and saving the updated PDFs.

concurrent-insert-delete-pdf.title: Concurrent Insert and Delete Operations on a PDF
concurrent-insert-delete-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to safely perform simultaneous page insertions and deletions on the same PDF using Aspose.Pdf with multithreading and file locking.

backup-pdf-and-flatten-form-fields.title: Backup PDF and Flatten Form Fields
backup-pdf-and-flatten-form-fields.description: Demonstrates how to create a backup of a PDF before flattening all interactive form fields using Aspose.Pdf and the Form facade.

get-annotation-counts-from-pdf.title: Get Annotation Counts from PDF
get-annotation-counts-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to extract all annotations from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor and count the occurrences of each annotation type.

skip-readonly-annotations-when-flattenin.title: Skip Read‑Only Annotations When Flattening PDF
skip-readonly-annotations-when-flattenin.description: Shows how to flatten PDF annotations in batch while optionally skipping those marked as read‑only using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

log-pdf-annotation-operations-duration.title: Log PDF Annotation Operation Durations
log-pdf-annotation-operations-duration.description: Demonstrates a wrapper around Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor that measures and logs the execution time of each annotation operation for performance monitoring.

delete-annotations-export-xfdf.title: Delete Specific Annotations and Export Remaining to XFDF
delete-annotations-export-xfdf.description: Demonstrates how to remove all annotations of a given type (e.g., Text) from a PDF using PdfAnnotationEditor and then export the remaining annotations to an XFDF file.

retry-annotation-modification-exponentia.title: Retry Annotation Modification with Exponential Backoff
retry-annotation-modification-exponentia.description: Demonstrates how to modify PDF annotations using Aspose.Pdf with a retry policy that applies exponential backoff for transient file access errors.

list-pdf-annotations-to-csv.title: List PDF Annotations with Page Numbers to CSV
list-pdf-annotations-to-csv.description: Shows how to extract all annotations from a PDF, obtain each annotation's name and page number, and export the data to a CSV file using Aspose.Pdf.

add-custom-metadata-to-pdf-annotation.title: Add Custom Metadata to a PDF Annotation
add-custom-metadata-to-pdf-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to create a TextAnnotation, store custom key/value metadata using PdfFileInfo, optionally modify the annotation with PdfAnnotationEditor, and save the PDF.

batch-remove-old-annotations.title: Batch Remove Old Annotations from PDFs
batch-remove-old-annotations.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through PDFs in a folder and delete annotations whose modification date is older than a specified number of days using Aspose.Pdf.

check-duplicate-annotation-names.title: Check for Duplicate Annotation Names in a PDF
check-duplicate-annotation-names.description: Shows how to iterate through all annotations in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, detect duplicate annotation names, and write a detailed report to a log file.

extract-pdf-annotation-comments-summary.title: Extract PDF Annotation Comments and Create Summary PDF
extract-pdf-annotation-comments-summary.description: Demonstrates how to extract text‑type annotation comments from an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, compile them into a single summary string, and generate a new PDF containing that summary.

flatten-pdf-annotations__v2.title: Flatten PDF Annotations to Static Graphics
flatten-pdf-annotations__v2.description: Demonstrates how to flatten all interactive annotations in a PDF, converting them to static graphics while preserving their visual appearance.

merge-annotation-layers-from-multiple-pd.title: Merge Annotation Layers from Multiple PDFs
merge-annotation-layers-from-multiple-pd.description: Demonstrates how to import annotation layers from several source PDFs into a target PDF and save the combined document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

pdfannotationeditor-health-check.title: Health Check for PdfAnnotationEditor Binding
pdfannotationeditor-health-check.description: Creates a minimal PDF if missing and verifies that PdfAnnotationEditor can bind to the document without errors, serving as a simple health check.

batch-export-delete-annotations-xfdf.title: Batch Export Annotations to XFDF and Remove Them
batch-export-delete-annotations-xfdf.description: Shows how to process a folder of PDFs, export all annotations to XFDF files for archiving, delete the annotations, and save the cleaned PDFs using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

flatten-pdfs-save-to-custom-output-direc.title: Flatten PDFs and Save to Custom Output Directory
flatten-pdfs-save-to-custom-output-direc.description: Demonstrates how to flatten PDF form fields using Aspose.Pdf and save the resulting PDFs to a user‑specified output folder, preserving original file names.

log-file-sizes-after-flattening-pdf-anno.title: Log File Sizes After Flattening PDF Annotations
log-file-sizes-after-flattening-pdf-anno.description: Demonstrates how to flatten all annotations in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and log the original and resulting file sizes for audit purposes.

update-annotation-subject.title: Update Annotation Subject Using PdfAnnotationEditor
update-annotation-subject.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF with a TextAnnotation, modify its Subject property using PdfAnnotationEditor.ModifyAnnotations, and verify the change with a unit test.

batch-delete-pdf-annotations-retain-type.title: Batch Delete PDF Annotations While Retaining Specified Types
batch-delete-pdf-annotations-retain-type.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, read a JSON configuration that lists annotation types to keep, and delete all other annotations using Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor.

flatten-pdf-annotations-from-stream.title: Flatten PDF Annotations from Stream
flatten-pdf-annotations-from-stream.description: Shows how to flatten all annotations in a PDF provided as a stream and return the modified PDF in a MemoryStream, avoiding any disk I/O.

flatten-pdf-tag-flattened-date.title: Flatten PDF and Tag with Flattened Date Metadata
flatten-pdf-tag-flattened-date.description: The example loads a PDF, flattens all form fields and annotations, saves it, and then adds a custom metadata entry "FlattenedDate" containing the current UTC timestamp using the Aspose.Pdf Facades API.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-with-diag.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF with Diagnostic Logging
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-with-diag.description: Demonstrates how to export all PDF annotations to an XFDF file using Aspose.Pdf and simultaneously write the same XFDF content to a diagnostic log file.

clone-annotation-change-color.title: Clone PDF Annotation, Change Its Color, and Add to Another Page
clone-annotation-change-color.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, clone an existing annotation, modify its color, and place the cloned annotation on a different page using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-delete-pdf-annotations-azure-blob.title: Batch Delete PDF Annotations from Azure Blob Storage
batch-delete-pdf-annotations-azure-blob.description: Demonstrates how to enumerate PDF blobs in an Azure Blob container, stream each PDF into Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor, delete all annotations, and upload the edited file back to another container.

generate-annotation-summary-report.title: Generate Annotation Summary Report for PDFs
generate-annotation-summary-report.description: The utility scans all PDF files in a folder, extracts annotations using Aspose.Pdf, counts each annotation type, and writes a summary report to a text file.

conditional-pdf-flattening.title: Conditional PDF Flattening Based on Digital Signatures
conditional-pdf-flattening.description: The example checks if a PDF contains digital signatures using PdfFileSignature and only flattens form fields and annotations when no signatures are present, preserving signature validity.

rename-pdf-annotation-names.title: Rename PDF Annotation Names with Standard Prefix
rename-pdf-annotation-names.description: Shows how to iterate through all annotations in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, prepend a standardized prefix to each annotation's name, and save the modified document.

manage-pdf-annotations-verbose.title: Flatten, Export, Import and Delete PDF Annotations with Verbose Logging
manage-pdf-annotations-verbose.description: The example loads a PDF, uses PdfAnnotationEditor to flatten all annotations, exports and re‑imports them via XFDF, deletes specific annotation types, and optionally logs each step with a --verbose flag.

test-export-annotations-unbound-editor.title: Test ExportAnnotations throws on unbound PdfAnnotationEditor
test-export-annotations-unbound-editor.description: Demonstrates how to verify that calling ExportAnnotationsToXfdf on a PdfAnnotationEditor that hasn't been bound to a PDF document throws an exception.

report-pdf-annotations-by-author.title: Report PDF Annotations Grouped by Author
report-pdf-annotations-by-author.description: Shows how to extract all annotations from a PDF, group them by the author (Title property of markup annotations), and output a simple console report.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-custom-na.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF with Custom Namespace
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-custom-na.description: Shows how to export all annotations from a PDF to XFDF using Aspose.Pdf, then replace the default XFDF namespace with a custom enterprise namespace before saving the file.

monitor-folder-flatten-pdf-annotations.title: Monitor Folder and Flatten PDF Annotations
monitor-folder-flatten-pdf-annotations.description: Shows a background service that watches a directory for new PDF files and uses Aspose.Pdf to flatten all annotations, saving the flattened PDFs to an output folder.

validate-pdf-integrity-after-annotation.title: Validate PDF Integrity After Adding Text Annotation
validate-pdf-integrity-after-annotation.description: Demonstrates adding a text annotation to a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, saving the modified file, and then validating the document for corrupted objects while logging the results.

export-pdf-annotations-to-compressed-xfd.title: Export PDF Annotations to Compressed XFDF
export-pdf-annotations-to-compressed-xfd.description: Demonstrates how to export all annotations from a PDF to XFDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor and then compress the XFDF data with GZip for efficient storage.

import-xfdf-into-pdf-cleanup.title: Import XFDF into PDF and Delete Temporary File
import-xfdf-into-pdf-cleanup.description: Demonstrates how to import XFDF data into a PDF using the Form facade and then remove the temporary XFDF file after a successful import.
